restatement: ArmadaLean/PoolSafety.lean states the theorem owned_merge_can_happen. The theorem describes an owner who holds 1 to 8 live notes of one token. The notes sit at distinct leaf positions in one tree. The owner can spend all the notes in one owned transact step. The step produces one output note. The output note holds the summed value of the input notes. The circuit's range check must accept the sum. After the step, no input note stays live. The output note is live. The pool's custody of the token stays the same. So the step conserves value. The theorem's proof body is currently the placeholder word `sorry`. The proof does not yet exist. This request asks the worker to complete the proof. The finished proof must carry no `sorry` in its own body. The repository already has a deterministic check for this fact. `scripts/check.sh --json <theorem-name>` builds the project. The script lists every theorem whose proof body still carries `sorry`. The script echoes back the queried theorem name. A predicate can then confirm that name is absent from the list. The proof counts as complete when this check, run for owned_merge_can_happen, reports the theorem absent from the list of unfinished proofs.
